title: Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

reading.body:
A self-driving car operated by Avride struck and killed a duck in Austin, Texas while operating in autonomous mode with a human safety operator present. The vehicle did not slow down or stop before hitting the duck. This shows a failure in object detection or classification, where the system either did not recognize the duck as an obstacle or did not treat it as one requiring avoidance. To catch this failure before deployment would have required testing the system's responses to small animals in its path.

A resident claimed the vehicle also failed to stop at a stop sign, though Avride disputed this after reviewing the vehicle's data. Whether that claim is accurate is not established. After the incident, Avride adjusted its testing area and stated it is evaluating technology improvements, including controlled simulations, though what those improvements are is not specified. The gap between what occurred and what detection systems were actually in place remains unclear.

reports.title: A self-driving car in Texas hit and killed a mother duck, sparking neighborhood outrage
Residents say self-driving car killed duck in Mueller
Self-driving car runs over Mueller Lake Park duck, raising safety concerns
Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

summary:
An autonomous vehicle operated by Avride struck and killed a mother duck in the Mueller Lake neighborhood of Austin, Texas, prompting significant community concern. The incident occurred when the self-driving car, which had a human safety operator present, hit the duck without slowing down or stopping. The duck had been nesting in a pot outside a local restaurant, making it familiar to residents, which intensified their anger. A resident also claimed the vehicle failed to stop at a stop sign, though Avride disputed this claim after reviewing vehicle data.

Following the incident, Avride confirmed the vehicle was operating in autonomous mode at the time and adjusted its testing operations by excluding certain streets around the lake. The company stated it is now evaluating technology improvements to prevent similar situations, including running controlled simulations to ensure safety remains unaffected. Local residents have preserved the duck's eggs in an incubator. Other autonomous vehicle companies, including Waymo, Tesla, and Zoox, also operate in Austin.
